title: Cheat-Recipe
description: This mod allows you to get Bedrock, Barrier Blocks, light and Debug Sticks in Survival Mode, in addition to these items it also adds an extra recipe that allows you to craft Nether Stars
body:
🛠️ Cheat Recipe
Have you ever had a modpack where an item was impossible to craft? Or are you playing on a private server and want to make access to powerful items easier?

Cheat Recipe is a small but fine utility mod designed for exactly that. It adds alternative, simpler recipes for items that are usually extremely hard to get or not craftable at all.

✨ Features
Simple Recipes: Gain access to items via intuitive and cost-effective recipes.

Perfect for Servers: Ideal for private projects with friends to speed up the gameplay flow.

Lightweight: The mod does not affect your game's performance and can be easily integrated into any modpack.

📖 Why this mod?
I originally created this mod for my friends to avoid annoying "grinding." Now I'm sharing it with the community! It is the perfect solution for everyone who wants more freedom in building and survival without having to be in Creative Mode constantly.

🚀 Versions & Support
Version: 1.19.4 / 1.20.1 / 1.20.4 / 1.21.1 / 1.21.4 / 1.21.8 

Loader: NeoForge / Forge / Fabric

Hobby Project: This mod is a leisure project. Updates appear when I find the time or when new ideas come from my friends.

☕ Support
If you like my work, feel free to support me on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/murieli44)! Every "coffee" helps me stay motivated and continue tinkering with my little projects.
